mechanism: Rasagiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor that at higher doses inhibits MAO-A, potentiating sympathomimetic effects and potentially increasing blood pressure; irbesartan's antihypertensive effect may be counteracted while hypotensive episodes remain possible.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during concurrent use; educate patient on avoiding tyramine-rich foods and sympathomimetic agents; consider alternative antiparkinsonian agents if blood pressure becomes difficult to control.
